Schnittstelle Higher3<WT extends WitnessType, A, B, C>

Typparameter:
WT - The witness type of the HKT (see WitnessType)
A - The first type parameter carried by this HKT
B - The second type parameter carried by this HKT
C - The third type parameter carried by this HKT
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Hkt<WT>
public interface Higher3<WT extends WitnessType, A, B, C> extends Hkt<WT>

Base interface for rank‑3 higher‑kinded types (HKTs).

This interface represents higher‑kinded types that have exactly three type parameters. It is typically used to model abstractions that are parameterized by three types, such as certain third‑order functors or similar constructs. The WT parameter acts as the witness type (see WitnessType) to encode the HKT at the type level.

  • Methodendetails

    • arity

      default int arity()

      Returns the rank (arity) of the higher‑kinded type.

      Since this HKT has exactly three type parameters, this method always returns 3.

      Angegeben von:
      arity in Schnittstelle Hkt<WT extends WitnessType>
      Gibt zurück:
      3, because this HKT has exactly three type parameters
